headline: Training your salon team in North Wales: the routes, the costs, and the trade-offs
description: Four routes to a trained team — apprentice, regulated unit, attendance course, in-house — set out neutrally with the costs and trade-offs, including the routes we do not sell.

mainEntity.name: How do I cover someone who is training?

acceptedAnswer.text: One person, one day a week. Our shortest unit is a single day; the longest is {{cpd:daysWord:UNHB374}}. Every date for the term is published in advance so you can build the rota once.

mainEntity.name: Can I send two people without losing both on the same day?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We run the same units on {{cpd:strandDays}}. Most salons close on a Monday, some cannot, and a salon sending two people can send them on different days rather than losing both at once.
Team rates count people from your salon across the whole term, not bookings on one date, so one stylist on colour and two on extensions already reaches the first tier. One invoice.
Our prices come from a published formula, the same one for everybody. There is no negotiated rate you missed out on.
